output.body: Take a countdown function: countdown(n) prints n and then calls countdown(n-1). Called alone it would run through 2, 1, 0, -1 and never end. It ends only if one input, say n == 0, is handled by returning right away with no further call, so the chain of calls reaches that input and stops.
output.key_idea: A recursive function stops when some input is handled directly, without calling itself again.
